_doc: Guided tutorial tips, shown in order. level '' = anywhere. done_on = the action that completes the tip (see autoload/tutorial.gd). Placeholders like {attack} become the right key/button for the current device.

tips.text: Go to the stairs and press {interact} to use them. {interact} also talks to people and opens chests.

tips.after_step: Meet Manos at the training field
tips.text: Open the chest next to Manos with {interact} to get a sword.
Attack with {attack}. Aim with the {aim}. Hit a training dummy!
Press {attack} three times in rhythm for a combo. The third hit is a powerful finisher.
Press {inventory} to open your inventory, stats and quest log. Spend upgrade points there when you level up.
Enemies flash red right before they strike. Dash with {dash} - you can't be hurt while dashing, and it cancels your attack.
Hurt? Drink a potion with {heal}. Chests hold more potions.
